plan.notes: Official 'Major Map' (recommended course sequence) from the University of South Carolina 2026-2027 bulletin. All 8 semesters transcribed verbatim; row sums match declared term totals (17/17/15/15/16/16/12/16); Minimum Total Hours 124. Ranged slots transcribed at values fitting the plan's totals: Basic Science, Foundational Math/Science, ESM, and Career electives at 3cr; CMS and GFL at 0. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
